title: The Bell of Harrow Glen
author: Isandro Nystrom
blurb: Ivo Eriksen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
